entries.title: US, Djiboutian partners exchange readiness knowledge, enhance real-world operations (8802086).jpg
entries.description: A member of the Djiboutian Coast Guard practices using a radio during a joint training exercise with the 82nd Expeditionary Rescue Squadron (ERQS) on Moucha Island, Djibouti, November 4, 2024. The training focused on effective communication and coordination techniques, essential skills for successful search and rescue operations. (U.S. Air Force photo by Staff Sgt. Jana Somero)
entries.creator: U.S. Air Force photo by Staff Sgt. Jana Somero

entries.title: US, Djiboutian partners exchange readiness knowledge, enhance real-world operations (8802085).jpg
entries.description: A pararescueman assigned to the 82nd Expeditionary Rescue Squadron (ERQS) demonstrates to members of the Djiboutian Coast Guard how to use their radio during a joint training exercise with the 82nd Expeditionary Rescue Squadron (ERQS) on Moucha Island, Djibouti, November 4, 2024. The training focused on effective communication and coordination techniques, essential skills for successful search and rescue operations. (U.S. Air Force photo by Staff Sgt. Jana Somero)

entries.title: Photograph of President Gerald R. Ford Meeting with Edward Gierek, First Secretary of the Central Committee of the Polish United Workers' Party (PZPR), in the Oval Office - NARA - 7462055.jpg
entries.description: Scope and content: President Ford and Edward Gierek, First Secretary of the Central Committee of the Polish United Workers' Party (PZPR), meet in the Oval Office during an official State visit. Also present are Deputy Prime Minister of the Planning Commission of the Polish People's Republic Mieczyslaw Jagielski, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Polish People's Republic Stephan Olszowska, Secretary of State Henry Kissinger, National Security Advisor Lt. Gen. Brent Scowcroft, and interpreter Henryk Sokalski.
